title: Sunday Sessions // When People Lived With People

top_liked.author: @psikeyhackr6914
top_liked.text:
My mother used an ironing comb on my sisters' hair. When I was 5 I was sitting at the kitchen table staring at the ironing comb sitting on the stove with the flames coming up over the teeth of the comb. I was thinking, "Damn that thing must be HOT!"

My mother picked up the comb…
